fixes.explanation: Yes, friend, you got it. "Behold, one will come up like a lion from the thickets of the Jordan to the watered pasture." That's the spot the verse names. Then God says, "…in an instant I will chase Babylon from her land." I always picture a lion coming out of tall brush when nobody expected it.
